mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE did = #{did}
SELECT course_id, name, credit, hours, capacity FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (name, credit, hours, capacity) VALUES (#{name}, #{credit}, #{hours}, #{capacity})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET name = #{name}, credit = #{credit}, hours = #{hours}, capacity = #{capacity} WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
